high_level_description: The image depicts a woman sitting on a concrete surface in a lush, green garden. She is wearing an elegant, light pink lehenga with intricate embroidery and sequins. The lehenga has a flowing skirt that extends outward, creating a dramatic silhouette. She is accessorized with large, round earrings and a bracelet on her right wrist. The background features a variety of tropical plants and flowers. There are tall, spiky cacti to the right, and a bush with vibrant red flowers in the center. To the left, there are more green plants and a smaller bush with orange flowers.
